hbm_generation.description: The specific generation of High-Bandwidth Memory to simulate.

stack_height.description: Number of DRAM dies per HBM stack (e.g., 8-Hi, 12-Hi).

pin_speed_gbps.description: Data rate per pin in Gigabits per second.

bus_width_bits.description: Total width of the data bus per stack.

packaging_tech.description: 2.5D or 3D packaging technology used for integration.
